spans.s: To break, violate, cut off, destroy, injure; अनुभवं वचसा सखि लुम्पसि
To take away, deprive of, rob, plunder.
To elide, suppress, cause to disappear. -Pass. (लुप्यते)
To be broken or violated; be lost; तस्य भागो न लुप्यते
To be elided or lost, to disappear (in gram.). -Caus. (ललोप- यति-ते)
To break, violate, infringe, offend against.
To cause to swerve from; सात्याद् गुरुमललोपयन्
Lost, deprived of; सा लुप्तसंज्ञा न विवेद दुःखम्
Obsolete, disused, out of use; see लुप्.

Elliptical (as opp. to पूर्ण, in Rhet.). -प्तम् Stolen property, booty.-Comp. -उपमा a mutilated or elliptical simile, i. e. an upamā in which one, two, or even three of the four requisites of a simile are omitted; see K.
under उपमा. -धर्मक्रिय a. excluded or deprived of religious ordinances; नाकन्यासु क्वचिन्नॄणां लुप्तधर्मक्रिया हि ताः
. -पद a. wanting in words. -पिण्डोदकक्रिय a. deprived of the funeralrites. -प्रतिज्ञ a. one who has broken his promise, faithless, perfidious. -प्रतिभ a. deprived of reason.
